alerts.headline: Nifty IT jumps over 2% as Wipro, Infosys, HCL Tech rally; Indian IT stocks defy global AI weakness
alerts.summary: Nifty IT surged over 2 percent as Wipro, Infosys and HCL Tech led gains, extending Indian IT stocks' recent outperformance amid weakness in global AI stocks. Receding expectations of a larger US Fed rate hike also offered a favourable backd
second_order_candidates: Winner: Wipro, Infosys, HCL Tech (INFY, WIPRO, HCLTECH): large-cap IT services seen as insulated from the AI-disruption selloff abroad and a rupee/dollar-revenue beneficiary; sector-wide rotation, not company-specific.
Losers: none clear; a sector round-up names no displaced company (smaller mid-cap IT with heavier exposure to AI-substitutable work may lag, but the article does not say so).
Catalyst: surprise - relative-strength rotation, no dated trigger; likely fades if global AI-weakness narrative turns against Indian IT.

alerts.headline: LG Electronics India shares fall 3% after Rs 2,464-crore block deals; promoters likely sell 2% equity stake
alerts.summary: The block deals in LG Electronics India came a day after its South Korean promoter announced plans to divest up to 2 percent stake by December 31 to comply with minimum public shareholding requirements.
second_order_candidates: Winner: block-deal buyers (institutions) get stock at a discount; selling promoter (parent) monetises stake and lifts free float.
Losers: LG Electronics India (LGEINDIA) holders short term: overhang from promoter selling and added supply at a discount price; no listed peer is directly displaced.
Catalyst: surprise - block deal, discount-driven pressure; typically absorbed within days, lock-in/further-sale disclosures are the thing to watch.
